final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_list_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_size_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_size_per_millisecond) AS across_media_type_average FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.media_type_name, ma.average_list_price, ma.average_size_per_millisecond, ma.average_size_per_millisecond / o.across_media_type_average AS relative_average FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.across_media_type_average IS NOT NULL
